name: Swift Woo Search – eCommerce Live Search
author: pantherius

sections.description:
Swift Woo Search (Free) replaces the default WooCommerce search with a blazing fast, AJAX-powered live search experience.
Show instant product results with thumbnails, prices and titles – without reloading the page.

This free version is lightweight, responsive and compatible with any modern WooCommerce theme.
It is a great upgrade for any shop looking to improve search usability and customer experience.

💡 Need more power? Upgrade to the Pro version for advanced features and full control:
👉 Get Swift Woo Search Pro →

Free Version Features

  • Instant AJAX product search
  • Mobile- and desktop-optimized search overlay
  • Product image, title, and price in results
  • Smart result ordering with custom scoring
  • Category and tag fallback logic (if no match)
  • Custom “Search more” link to full results
  • Built-in analytics and search logging
  • Polylang & WPML compatibility
  • Lightweight, SEO-friendly & accessible
  • Fully responsive – works with all major WooCommerce themes

Upgrade to Pro

Unlock the full power of Swift Woo Search with the Pro version:

🔥 Pro features include:
* Customizable search design and layout options
* Image zoom, badges, and advanced price display
* Index-based fuzzy search using local database
* Performance-optimized search index (SQLite)
* Search by SKU, tags, category, and custom fields
* Weighted scoring by keyword position and relevance
* Search logs with export and trend analysis
* Enhanced multilingual support
* Priority support and updates

🔗 Compare plans & get Swift Woo Search Pro →
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/swift-woo-search directory or install via the WordPress admin panel.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. A new search icon will appear in your main navigation (you can change its location if needed).
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with my theme?

Yes, it is designed to be compatible with all major WooCommerce themes.

Does it compatible with multilanguage Woocommerce stores?

Yes, it is compatible with WPML and Polylang.

Can I customize the search design?

Yes, the plugin includes flexible styling via its CSS file, which you can override or modify.

Does it affect the native WooCommerce search?

Yes – it enhances it by replacing the default logic with a smarter, weighted algorithm that returns better product matches.

Does it slow down my site?

No. The plugin is built to be extremely fast, using pure JavaScript and optimized AJAX calls.
